description: MainActivity.kt for an Android application implementing a calculator with voice input, dark/light theme toggling, calculation history, and AI-generated explanations. The class manages UI elements, user interactions, expression evaluation, and voice recognition integration.

classes.name: HistoryItem
classes.description: Data class representing an entry in the calculation history, including user input, result, and AI explanation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets theme, and setups event listeners when activity is created.

methods.name: setupCalculatorButtonListeners
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to calculator buttons for inserting numbers/operators into input field.

methods.name: setupTheme
methods.description: Applies the specified theme (dark or light) by changing background and text colors.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between dark and light themes.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for UI elements like buttons related to submitting queries, voice input, theme toggling, and history display.

methods.name: setupHistoryList
methods.description: Initializes and updates the calculation history ListView.

methods.name: fillFromHistory
methods.description: Populates the input field with a selected history item.

methods.name: toggleHistoryPanel
methods.description: Shows or hides the calculation history panel.

methods.name: processUserQuery
methods.description: Handles user input, evaluates the expression, and updates the UI with results and explanation.

methods.name: showResult
methods.description: Displays calculation result and AI explanation.

methods.name: addToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation entry to the history list.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Performs simplified evaluation of expressions or natural language commands, returning result and explanation.

methods.name: startVoiceInput
methods.description: Initiates voice recognition, requesting permission if necessary, and processes recognized speech.
